math.title: Math / See the optimum move
math.heading: Move a variable. See why the answer changes.
math.description: Explore one optimization problem through its geometry, coordinate paths, objective and constraints. The diagrams follow the exact solution; the proof is one click away.
metrics: follow the reasoning behind the picture
tour: Change one incentive. Every graph follows the same exact solution.
Inside the polygon, the optimum moves freely. No inequality is binding.
At this corner, the optimum holds while the objective value changes.
Along the slanted edge, x and y rise. Zero slack identifies the limit.
The x cap ends movement. Two boundaries now bind.
Inspect the certificate, exact proof and executable checks behind this worked example.

swarm.title: Cohort / Coordinated agent teams
swarm.heading: Give every agent a job. Keep one shared result.
swarm.description: Watch specialists turn a brief into a working reading room. Follow dependencies, inspect handoffs, and retry a failed task while keeping the accepted work.
tour: Give each role a clear handoff. Build the journal with a deliberately faulty Data candidate.
One duplicate note ID stops the merge. The graph keeps three accepted outputs and shows exactly what is waiting.
Retry only Data. Interface, Accessibility, and the specification keep their original artifacts.
The valid handoffs rejoin. Separate review and release finish the product; the chart records every real dispatch round.
Six computed checks inspect the accepted records and composed markup before release is allowed.
The team delivers a working reading journal. Choose a book, save a thought, or add a note; every handoff is inspectable.

memory.title: Continuum / Project memory
memory.heading: Your next task should not start from zero.
memory.description: Ask a project question and retrieve the decisions behind it, with their sources. See an old decision give way to its replacement, then save a new one and find it again.
metrics: trace each decision to its record
current decisions stay distinct from history
tour: A new task begins with the current project record: relevant decisions, constraints and next steps, each with a source.
Ask about saving notes. The graph and the context brief update together; unrelated records remain outside the brief.
Follow a changed decision. The old account-first proposal is preserved and points to the current local-notes decision.
Keep a useful new decision in the project record.
The next question can retrieve that decision immediately, with its source. The context brief is downloadable.

code.title: Tidy / Readable, executable code
code.heading: Understand the code. Check what it actually does.
code.description: Turn a mixed task inbox into a clean project plan. Edit the input, read the function that runs, and trace accepted, duplicate and rejected rows into the actual result.
metrics: The source is the running function
try edge cases and inspect the behavior
tour: Readable code turns this messy inbox into a real project plan.
Lower the per-task limit. The plan, totals and row decisions all change together.
Inspect the exact function that just ran, with its validation kept explicit.
A negative estimate stops processing before any partial plan appears.
At the boundary: sixty minutes is included, sixty-one is excluded, and zero is valid.
Rerun executable checks for duplicates, malformed input, boundary values and unchanged source data.
